jobs.title: Director, Cloud Governance & Controls Engineering
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 261595

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Role

The Director, Cloud Governance & Controls Engineering is responsible for establishing, operationalizing, and continuously enhancing a fully automated control and governance framework for cloud platforms within a highly regulated global financial institution. This role provides enterprise leadership to ensure that cloud infrastructure and platform services are designed, built, and operated with appropriate risk management, regulatory compliance, and security controls embedded by default across the full technology lifecycle.

Reporting directly to the Senior Vice President & Global Head, Global Banking & Markets Engineering, the role blends governance accountability with a strong engineering mindset. The Director partners closely with independent risk, compliance, and control functions to define a comprehensive control inventory, while leading the automation and enforcement of those controls through scalable cloud engineering frameworks. This position plays a critical role in enabling safe cloud adoption at scale, supporting innovation while meeting regulatory and audit expectations.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

Own the design, implementation, and ongoing evolution of the cloud controls and governance framework, ensuring alignment with regulatory, risk, security, and audit requirements applicable to financial services.
Partner with independent risk, compliance, and control functions to establish and maintain a comprehensive, well‑defined control inventory for cloud infrastructure and platform services.
Lead the automation and enforcement of controls across the cloud lifecycle, embedding guardrails into engineering platforms, pipelines, and reference architectures.
Build and lead a high‑performing team of 3–4 specialists responsible for translating control requirements into scalable engineering solutions and reusable frameworks.
Collaborate with product and platform Technical Program Managers to ensure controls are captured early in design and consistently applied through build, deployment, and operations.
Define and oversee engineering‑led governance mechanisms, including dashboards, interfaces, and metrics that provide real‑time visibility into control effectiveness and compliance posture.
Influence cloud strategy and platform roadmaps to ensure risk and control considerations are addressed without compromising developer productivity or time to market.
Support internal and external audits, regulatory inquiries, and management reviews by providing clear evidence of automated control design and operation.
Establish standards, policies, and patterns that promote secure‑by‑design and compliant‑by‑default cloud engineering practices.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience.
Extensive experience in cloud engineering, platform engineering, or cloud security within largescale, regulated environments.
Demonstrated experience designing and implementing automated controls, policy‑as‑code, and governance frameworks across IaaS and PaaS platforms.
Proven people‑leadership experience, including building and leading small, specialized technical teams.
Experience in financial services, capital markets, or other highly regulated industries.
Deep familiarity with public cloud platforms and modern control enforcement techniques (e.g., policy‑as‑code, CI/CD integration, cloud security posture management).
Experience engaging with regulators, auditors, and second‑line risk functions on technology control matters.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to influence senior technology and risk leaders.

What's in it for you?

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove, and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.
Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.
Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days, and benefits will start on day one.
Community Engagement - no matter where you choose to work from; we offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs.

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you require accommodation (including, but not limited to, an accessible interview site, alternate format documents, ASL Interpreter, or Assistive Technology) during the recruitment and selection process, please let our Recruitment team know. If you require technical assistance, please click here. Candidates must apply directly online to be considered for this role. We thank all applicants for their interest in a career at Scotiabank; however, only those candidates who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Business Applications
jobs.description:
Hammond Power Solutions Inc.
is a global manufacturer headquartered in Guelph, Ontario, Canada. HPS has grown to become the leader in North America in the custom design and manufacture of dry type transformers. For the past century, HPS has grown to deliver electrical power solutions to global markets and provides solutions for complex applications like, mining, rectifier, drives, traction, wind, solar and many other electrical power applications. The world relies on HPS to continually conceive and produce state-of-the-art transformer technology. We currently have an opening for a Director, Enterprise Business Applications,
come grow with us!

Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, the Director, Enterprise Business Applications is accountable for the strategy, performance, and evolution of the organization’s enterprise business application portfolio. This role ensures that core platforms supporting manufacturing, supply chain, finance, commercial, P&C, and corporate functions are reliable, scalable, secure, and aligned with business priorities in a multinational manufacturing environment, while driving responsible adoption of AI-enabled capabilities.

Key Responsibilities Include

Define and execute a multi-year enterprise applications strategy aligned with business objectives and operating priorities
Partner with business and functional leaders to translate needs into technology roadmaps and investment plans.
Oversee the performance, stability, and lifecycle management of enterprise applications, including incident, change, and release processes.
Lead modernization initiatives across ERP, CRM, HRIS, finance, and manufacturing systems to improve scalability and reduce technical debt.
Drive adoption of AI-enabled capabilities (e.g., vendor AI, Microsoft Copilot, custom solutions) to enhance productivity, decision-making, and automation.
Ensure AI-enabled features and automations are operated reliably, monitored effectively, and supported within standard service models.
Enable system integration, process standardization, and data-driven operations
Support M&A activities by assessing application and data landscapes, defining target-state architectures, and planning phased integrations, including AI and analytics alignment.
Manage budgets, vendors, and implementation partners, ensuring effective delivery and measurable business value (including software licensing, AI services, support and delivery partners)
Establish governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with cybersecurity, data, and regulatory requirements, and managing application and AI-related risk
Lead and develop global application teams, fostering a high-performance, collaborative, and outcome-focused culture.
Partner with risk, security, legal, and compliance teams to proactively identify and mitigate application and AI-related risks.

Do you qualify? We are seeking:

10+ years of experience in enterprise applications leadership
Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field (Master’s an asset)
Proven experience in complex, manufacturing-focused environments
Proven experience implementing and overseeing AI‑enabled business applications, including embedded vendor AI and productivity copilots, with awareness of data, security, and operational implications.
Strong expertise across ERP-centric ecosystems supporting supply chain, finance, HR, and operations
Solid understanding of application architecture, integration, and governance practices.
Demonstrated ability to translate business strategy into technology roadmaps and outcomes
Relevant certifications (PMP, Agile, ERP, Azure/AWS) considered an asset
Excellent communication and leadership skills

NOTE: Hammond Power Solutions encourages applications from all qualified candidates. HPS has a great record of accommodating persons with disabilities. Contact our People & Culture team if you need accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information on our accommodation policies.

Some Of The Benefits Of Working At Hammond

We are Great Place to Work Certified! Our people work hard for us—so we make sure our benefits work hard for them. Our equitable pay, benefits, and practices prioritize security, health, and well-being while sharing in our business success through variable pay programs and our Employee Stock Ownership Program.

Our core benefits focus on wellness, mental health, and financial security when employees need them the most, early career or getting ready for retirement. We also support work-life balance through flexible work schedules, paid time off, and leaves of absence. Employees and their families also have access to our confidential, best-in-class Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP).

We are committed to sustainable business practices and offer opportunities for our employees to support the communities where we live and work through our Hammond Giving Strategy.

jobs.title: Director, Business Planning & Central Operations
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Sitting within the broader Safety & Customer Care team, Lyft's Customer Care Operations organization manages over 1.7 million monthly customer interactions and serves as the company's primary direct touchpoint with riders, drivers, and businesses — spanning frontline support across multiple customer segments, a global BPO workforce, and the central functions that enable them to operate at scale.

The Director of Business Planning & Central Operations is a newly created role at the center of how Customer Care runs and grows. This leader will ensure the org is resourced and positioned for the future, and will own the functions that keep Customer Care financially disciplined and execution-ready. Reporting to the Senior Director of Customer Care Operations, they will lead five functions: Planning & Forecasting, Workforce Management, Readiness & Integration, Vendor Management, and Support Excellence.

What You'll Do

Business Planning & Strategy

Partner with the Senior Director to drive H1 and H2 planning — translating annual objectives into operational plans, investment decisions, and resource models.
Lead the investment brief process: sizing opportunities, articulating trade-offs, and building the business cases that secure resourcing for strategic priorities.
Drive capacity planning, scenario modeling, and long-range forecasting to ensure the internal and external workforce scales efficiently alongside platform growth and AI adoption.
Define and operationalize OKRs across the portfolio, then build the rhythms and infrastructure — scorecards, business reviews, and performance dashboards — that hold teams accountable and give leadership clear visibility into progress and outcomes.

Growth & Integrations

Lead operational readiness for major product launches, external partnerships, and platform expansions — ensuring Customer Care is prepared from scoping through hypercare.
Own the integration framework for new lines of business and strategic partnerships, including Lyft's expansion into autonomous vehicles and external mobility platforms.
Serve as the connective tissue between Customer Care and Product, Engineering, Legal, and Communications on initiatives with significant customer support implications.

Vendor & Financial Operations

Own financial operations across the portfolio, partnering with Finance and Workforce Management to maintain cost discipline, model the impact of product changes and AI automation, and invest strategically in quality and transformation.
Lead end-to-end management of Lyft's BPO vendor relationships — owning governance cadences, enterprise-level performance reviews, SLA enforcement, escalation management, and contract renewals, in close partnership with Procurement for new and renegotiated agreements.

People Leadership

Hire, develop, and retain high-performing teams.
Create clarity of ownership across a function that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and technology, where the decisions made show up directly in customer experience and cost structure.

What We're Looking For

10+ years in business strategy, operations, consulting, or investment banking, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role owning complex operational or strategic functions.
Strong financial and analytical foundation — comfortable building capacity models, stress-testing business cases, and translating the output into a crisp leadership narrative.
Experience leading or supporting large-scale growth initiatives, integrations, or partnerships, ideally in a marketplace or platform business.
AI fluency — you understand how AI is reshaping operations and can lead through that transformation with confidence.
Exceptional cross-functional partner — you build trust with Finance, Product, Tech, and Operations and can drive alignment across a matrixed organization.
Clear, direct, and decisive — you make decisions with the information available, communicate them crisply, and adapt when new data arrives.
Experience in customer support or contact center operations is a plus, not a requirement.
MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred; strong quantitative background required.

Benefits:

Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits

Lyft is committed to creating an inclusive workforce that fosters belonging. Lyft believes that every person has a right to equal employment opportunities without discrimination because of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, family status, disability, pardoned record of offences, or any other basis protected by applicable law or by Company policy. Lyft also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind. Accommodation for persons with disabilities will be provided upon request in accordance with applicable law during the application and hiring process. Please contact your recruiter if you wish to make such a request.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office at least 3 days per week, including on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid

Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. À propos de Pratt & Whitney Canada

Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) est un leader mondial de l’innovation aérospatiale, dont le siège social est situé à Longueuil, au Québec, depuis 1928. Nous concevons et fabriquons des moteurs d’aéronefs de nouvelle génération qui propulsent la plus grande flotte mondiale d’avions et d’hélicoptères dans les segments de l’aviation d’affaires, de l’aviation générale et de l’aviation régionale.

Depuis près de 100 ans, nos équipes sont à l’avant-garde des technologies de propulsion, repoussant les limites afin de rendre nos moteurs plus performants et fiables. Nos moteurs soutiennent des missions essentielles, du transport de passagers et de marchandises aux services médicaux d’urgence, aux opérations humanitaires et à la lutte contre les feux de forêt, partout dans le monde.

Un employeur de choix

Pratt & Whitney Canada a été reconnue comme l’un des meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2026 selon Forbes, et ce, pour une 11e année consécutive. L’entreprise s’est également classée au premier rang des employeurs de l’industrie de l’aérospatiale et de la défense au pays. De plus, notre siège social figure toujours parmi les meilleurs employeurs de la région de Montréal. Ensemble, ces distinctions confirment notre réputation d’employeur de choix à Montréal, au Canada et à l’échelle mondiale.

Le poste s’effectue à notre établissement de Longueuil du lundi au vendredi, selon des horaires flexibles et exclusivement en présentiel.

Indicateurs de performance

Assurer la production mensuelle des indicateurs de performance du département
Faire évoluer les processus de données sur la qualité client selon les normes les plus récentes et les positionner pour l'avenir.
Diriger une petite équipe de développeurs Power BI responsables des rapports départementaux.

Automatisation des processus

Agir en tant qu’analyste d’affaire et responsable de produit
Assurer la gestion d’un fournisseur externe de services de gestion de données pour soutenir l'amélioration des processus
Travailler en collaboration avec les équipes de solutions technologiques (DT) ainsi que les développeurs afin de tester et implanter les solutions en production.
Prioriser les éléments du back log en fonction de la valeur d'affaires, des risques, du ROI et des dépendances techniques.
Soutenir les forums d'utilisateurs et responsables d'unité d'affaires des processus afin de collecter leur requis de nouvelle solution ou améliorations;
Être un agent de transformation pour influencer sur l’amélioration des processus d’affaires
Communiquer l'avancement des projets et justifier les choix de priorisation.
Coordonner et exécuter le plan de test / Identifier les problèmes de test et participer à l’investigation;
Offrir du support aux utilisateurs lors de l’exécution des tests ‘’User Acceptance Testing’’ (UAT);
Faire appel à des compétences de gestion de projets, de prise de décisions en connaissant les risques encourus ainsi que de communiquer à différents niveaux;
Être un agent de changement en préparation au déploiement des nouvelles solutions
Préparer et présenter du matériel de formation à la suite du déploiement des nouvelles solutions

Formation gestionnaire d’échappé

Préparer et présenter le contenu pour la communauté de Pratique pour les gestionnaires d’échappé
Assurer la gouvernance du profil de formation des gestionnaires d’échappé.

Qu’est-ce qu’il vous faut pour réussir ?

Doit être ingénieux, prendre de l’initiative et être un joueur d’équipe;
Bonne connaissance des processus d’affaires en lien avec le produit ;
Fortes habiletés interpersonnelles et de communication;
Esprit orienté vers la résolution de problèmes;
Expérience avec le service à la clientèle, investigation et retour de communication avec le client;
Un atout si vous connaissez déjà Databricks, Power BI, SAP, ENOVIA, Confluence, JIRA, SharePoint, MS Office 365;

Ce poste s’inscrit dans un milieu de travail francophone, néanmoins il nécessite une connaissance fonctionnelle de l’anglais pour lire et comprendre des instructions spécialisées, des plans, des dessins et des termes techniques qui peuvent émaner d’organisations internationales, ainsi que pour écrire et parfois communiquer en anglais avec des clients, des fournisseurs ou des collègues internationaux.

Travailler chez Pratt & Whitney Canada

Chez Pratt & Whitney Canada, nous allions avec passion, audace et rigueur pour concevoir, fabriquer et entretenir les moteurs d’aéronefs les plus avancés et les plus fiables au monde. Notre travail et la qualité de nos produits contribuent au succès de nos clients, qui à leur tour sauvent des vies, soutiennent le commerce, connectent les communautés et protègent les libertés.

Chez Pratt & Whitney Canada, vous avez l’occasion de faire une différence tous les jours ; il suffit de lever les yeux. Êtes-vous prêt à vous dépasser ?

Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) is a global leader in aerospace innovation, proudly headquartered in Longueuil, Quebec, since 1928. We design and manufacture next-generation aircraft engines that power the world’s largest fleet of business, general aviation, and regional aircraft and helicopters.

For nearly 100 years, our teams have been at the forefront of propulsion technology, pushing boundaries to make flight more efficient and reliable. Our engines support missions that truly matter, from transporting people and essential goods, to enabling emergency medical services, humanitarian operations, and wildfire suppression around the world.

An Employer of Choice

Pratt & Whitney Canada was named one of Canada’s Best Employers for 2026 by Forbes, marking the 11th consecutive year the company has earned this recognition. Pratt & Whitney Canada also ranked #1 employer in the aerospace and defense industry in the country. In addition, our headquarters continue to be recognized among the top employers in the Montreal region. Together, these distinctions reinforce our reputation as an employer of choice in Montreal, across Canada, and around the world.

The position is based at our Longueuil location from Monday to Friday, with flexible hours and exclusively on-site.

Performance Indicators

Ensure the monthly production of departmental performance indicators.
Develop data processes related to customer quality in line with the latest standards and position them for the future.
Lead a small team of Power BI developers responsible for departmental reports.

Process Automation

Act as a business analyst and product owner.
Manage an external data management service provider to support process improvement.
Collaborate with technology solutions teams (DT) and developers to test and implement solutions in production.
Prioritize backlog items based on business value, risks, ROI, and technical dependencies.
Support user forums and business unit process leaders to gather their requirements for new solutions or improvements.
Act as a transformation agent to drive business process improvements.
Communicate project progress and justify prioritization decisions.
Coordinate and execute the test plan/identify testing issues and participate in investigations.
Provide support to users during User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
Utilize project management skills, make informed decisions understanding the associated risks, and communicate effectively across different levels.
Act as a change agent in preparation for the deployment of new solutions.
Prepare and deliver training materials following the deployment of new solutions.

Escape Management Training

Prepare and deliver content for the Community of Practice for Escape Leaders.
Ensure the governance of the training profile for Escape Leaders.

What do you need to succeed?

Must be resourceful, take initiative, and be a team player.
Strong knowledge of business processes related to the product.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Problem-solving-oriented mindset.
Experience in customer service, investigation, and providing customer feedback.
Experience with tools such as Databricks, Power BI, SAP, ENOVIA, Confluence, JIRA, SharePoint, MS Office 365 is an asset.

This position is part of a French-speaking work environment, it requires a very good knowledge of English to read and understand, on a daily basis, documentation and technical terms that may emanate from international organizations, as well as to write and communicate in English with customers, suppliers or international colleagues.

What do we offer?

Aperçu

A Propos De Nous

Depuis 1987, EDF solutions électriques fournit des solutions d'énergie propre aux États-Unis, au Canada et au Mexique. Nous sommes un producteur d'énergie indépendant et un fournisseur de services de premier plan sur le marché, offrant aux services publics, aux entreprises, aux industries, aux communautés, aux institutions et aux investisseurs des solutions énergétiques fiables et à faible émission de carbone qui aident à répondre à une demande croissante.

Du développement et de la construction de projets évolutifs dans l'éolien (terrestre et maritime), le solaire, le stockage (batteries et centrales hydroélectriques à pompage-turbinage), la recharge intelligente des véhicules électriques, les microréseaux, l'hydrogène vert et les projets de transmission, jusqu'à la maximisation de la performance et de la rentabilité grâce à des opérations et une maintenance qualifiées et une optimisation innovante des actifs, nos équipes fournissent des solutions expertes tout au long de la chaîne de valeur, de l'origine à l'exploitation commerciale.

Faites partie d'une équipe collaborative et innovante qui s'engage à fournir des solutions renouvelables pour promouvoir la transition vers un avenir énergétique durable.

Avantages Et Bénéfices

EDF solutions électriques offre des avantages sociaux de premier choix, dont les suivants:

Des bonis compétitifs. Ce poste est éligible à notre programme de bonis annuels.
Une couverture médicale complète. Nous fournissons une couverture santé et bien-être aux employés et leur personnes à charges.
REER/RPDP gratifiant. Nous fournissons une généreuse contribution de contrepartie.

Nous Sommes Également Fiers D'offrir

Des programmes de congés payés avantageux.
Des opportunités d'apprentissage, de développement de carrière et d'avancement gratifiantes.
Des programmes de mentorat et de jumelage.

Échelle salariale : La fourchette salariale complète pour ce poste est entre 144,700$ - 241,100$ par an, et le salaire de départ estimé pour ce poste à l'embauche est comp ris entre 165,000$ et 180,000$ par an. Nous basons généralement nos décisions salariales sur des facteurs tels que, entre autres, l'expérience professionnelle et le leadership, la formation, les performances démontrées, l'équité interne et, dans certains cas, la situation géographique.

Objectif de l'emploi : Le directeur.trice des rapports financiers supervise l'ensemble des activités comptables et des obligations en matière de reporting de l'équipe Canada - Finance.

Responsabilités

Responsabilités

Dirige et assure la communication relative à l'ensemble de la comptabilité et du reporting financier interne pour les activités canadiennes, y compris l'élaboration et la mise à jour des plans financiers, des prévisions, des budgets, des activités et projets en cours, ainsi que d'autres prévisions et projets prospectifs. Identifie les problèmes et formule des commentaires sur les résultats financiers trimestriels, les prévisions et les projections à l'intention de la direction générale.
Identifie, recrute, développe et fidélise les talents afin de garantir une équipe hautement performante ; renforce les équipes de comptabilité et de reporting à l'échelle de l'organisation. Encadre et développe les autres collaborateurs.
Garantit l'exactitude des prévisions et le rapprochement entre le budget et les prévisions réelles et historiques pour les opérations canadiennes. Supervise les audits, résout les problèmes d'audit et gère la conformité aux exigences canadiennes en matière de divulgation. S'assure que toutes les exigences relatives aux rapports internes et externes sont respectées.
Consolide, analyse et examine les données et indicateurs financiers pour le budget d'exploitation annuel du Canada. Dirige les examens, analyse et communique les rapports de coûts pour les projets organisationnels.
Supervise, développe et documente les processus tout en mettant en œuvre des solutions technologiques cohérentes avec, et favorisant la création d'une organisation consolidée qui répond aux besoins actuels et est évolutive pour la croissance future, tant organique qu'anorganique.
Agit en tant qu'interface principale entre la fonction financière et l'entreprise, plus précisément l'AO et les parties prenantes du développement, en s'assurant que toutes les exigences en matière de rapports sont respectées pour les besoins internes et externes, tels que les rapports destinés aux partenaires et aux prêteurs.

jobs.title: Field Chief Technology Officer - North America West
jobs.description:
1Password is growing.
We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Technical authority and commercial judgement create the bridge between architecture and business outcomes. As a 1Password Field Chief Technology Officer (Field CTO), you’ll help the world’s largest organizations navigate that bridge while shaping the future of enterprise identity security.

The Field CTO is the most senior customer-facing technical advisor within the 1Password Solutions Engineering organization. You’ll influence enterprise technology leaders, accelerate adoption of the 1Password platform and help define how modern organizations secure every sign-in to every application from every device, including AI agents.

You’ll partner with executive buyers, enterprise architects, developers and security practitioners to solve some of the industry’s most complex identity and access challenges. You’ll engage in our most strategic customer opportunities, represent 1Password in executive briefings, customer advisory boards, industry events and executive forums, and serve as a trusted advisor to Product, Engineering and GTM leadership. You’ll focus your efforts where executive technical leadership can materially influence customer outcomes, while transforming those experiences into repeatable technical motions that scale across the broader Solutions Engineering organization.

Beyond customer engagement, you’ll help scale the technical capabilities of the entire Solutions Engineering organization. You’ll transform customer insights into repeatable playbooks, mentor senior Solutions Engineers, influence product direction and establish technical strategies that improve how we engage enterprise customers around the world.

How We’re Using AI Today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What We're Looking For

12+ years of experience in enterprise technology, cybersecurity, consulting, solutions engineering, enterprise architecture or technical leadership roles.
Demonstrated success influencing executive technology leaders within Fortune 500 organizations.
Deep technical expertise across identity, access management, privileged access, cloud security, developer platforms, SaaS security or AI security.
Exceptional executive communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to simplify highly complex technical concepts into compelling narratives for executive audiences.
Proven ability to influence enterprise architecture decisions across large, complex organizations.
Experience supporting strategic enterprise sales opportunities and partnering closely with executive sales teams.
Strong understanding of enterprise buying processes and modern sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC.
Experience building technical strategies, reusable methodologies or customer engagement frameworks that scale beyond individual contributions.
Demonstrated ability to influence product strategy through customer engagement and market insights.
Proven ability to build trusted relationships across Product, Engineering, Sales and executive leadership while influencing without direct authority.
Experience speaking to diverse audiences at industry conferences, executive forums and analyst events.
Willingness to travel up to 50%.

Success in This Role

Within Your First 12 To 18 Months, You Will

Influence the successful outcome of 1Password’s most strategic customer opportunities and executive relationships.
Build trusted partnerships with Product, Engineering and GTM leadership that shape future platform investments.
Create repeatable technical plays, executive messaging and reference architectures adopted across the global Solutions Engineering organization.
Elevate the technical capabilities of the field through mentorship, thought leadership and executive engagement.
Expand 1Password’s influence across the identity security community through conference speaking, customer advisory boards and industry events.

What You Can Expect

Serve as a trusted technical advisor to strategic customers

Build relationships with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, Chief Architects and technical decision makers across Fortune 500 organizations.
Participate in executive briefings, architecture reviews and strategic workshops to help customers solve complex identity, access and security challenges.
Participate in executive customer meetings where senior technical leadership is needed to build consensus, align C-level priorities with technical teams and accelerate strategic initiatives.
Provide technical leadership throughout the sales cycle, helping account teams navigate architecture discussions, competitive evaluations and executive decision making.
Support our most strategic opportunities by accelerating technical alignment, reducing execution risk and building customer confidence.

Shape the Future of Solutions Engineering

Build repeatable technical motions, executive messaging, reference architectures and technical playbooks that scale across the global Solutions Engineering organization.
Mentor senior Solutions Engineers and help raise the technical and consultative capabilities of the broader team.
Partner with Sales Leadership, Solutions Engineering Leadership and Enablement to identify emerging technical trends, strategic opportunities and areas for organizational investment.
Develop enablement programs that prepare the field for emerging technologies and evolving customer challenges.
Serve as a technical thought leader across the organization, helping define best practices for enterprise engagement.

Influence Product Strategy

Serve as the executive voice of the field by bringing customer feedback, competitive intelligence and implementation insights directly to Product and Engineering leadership.
Partner with Product Management and Engineering to influence roadmap priorities, validate emerging capabilities and support early customer adoption programs.
Help translate emerging market trends into actionable product and GTM strategies.

Speak at conferences, executive events, customer advisory boards, analyst briefings and industry forums.
Develop technical thought leadership through presentations, blogs, webinars, whitepapers and executive content.
Build credibility with customers, industry analysts, strategic partners and the broader security community while strengthening 1Password’s market position.
Be called upon to join high-impact, in-person customer engagements where executive technical leadership can build alignment, accelerate decision-making and strengthen strategic relationships.
Serve as the executive technical face of 1Password for our most strategic customers and partners.
Shape how 1Password engages enterprise organizations around identity security, AI, developer security and modern access management.
Partner directly with executive leadership across Product, Engineering, Marketing and Go-to-Market to influence company strategy.
Help define the future of Solutions Engineering by mentoring technical leaders and building scalable customer engagement models.

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. Company Description
Canada Create™ is a Toronto-based digital marketing agency founded in 2008, specializing in web development, branding, SEO, social media marketing, and lead generation. The agency focuses on building complete, technology-driven brands for clients across diverse industries and global markets. A multicultural team environment encourages different perspectives, complementary skills, and adaptability to international clients. Creativity and openness are core values, supporting continuous innovation and the delivery of tailored digital solutions. Canada Create™ offers a collaborative setting for professionals who want to make a tangible impact on clients’ growth and visibility.
Role Description
The Head of Artificial Intelligence will lead the AI strategy and implementation across Canada Create™’s digital marketing, SEO, and web development services. This is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Toronto Area, Canada. Day-to-day responsibilities include identifying AI opportunities within agency workflows, designing and overseeing development of AI-powered tools for content optimization, customer segmentation, and performance analytics. The role involves managing data pipelines, guiding experimentation with machine learning models, and ensuring that AI solutions align with business goals, client needs, and ethical standards. The Head of AI will collaborate closely with developers, marketers, and leadership to integrate AI capabilities into client projects, mentor team members, and evaluate emerging technologies to keep the agency at the forefront of innovation.
Qualifications

Strong foundation in Computer Science, with expertise in algorithms, data structures, and software engineering practices.
Applied experience in Data Science, including data modeling, statistical analysis, and machine learning for real-world business problems.
Proficiency in Pattern Recognition, with the ability to design and evaluate models that detect trends and behaviors relevant to digital marketing.
Hands-on experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP), such as text classification, sentiment analysis, and content generation for marketing contexts.
Knowledge of Computer Vision techniques for tasks like image classification, asset tagging, and creative content enhancement.
Advanced skills in programming languages commonly used in AI (e.g., Python, R) and familiarity with frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.
Experience deploying AI solutions in production environments, including cloud platforms, APIs, and integration with web applications.
Leadership experience in AI or data teams, with the ability to mentor colleagues, manage projects, and communicate complex concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field; relevant industry certifications are an asset.
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and a commitment to responsible, inclusive, and privacy-conscious AI practices.

new_jobs.title: Field Chief Technology Officer - North America West
new_jobs.description:
1Password is growing.
We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Technical authority and commercial judgement create the bridge between architecture and business outcomes. As a 1Password Field Chief Technology Officer (Field CTO), you’ll help the world’s largest organizations navigate that bridge while shaping the future of enterprise identity security.

The Field CTO is the most senior customer-facing technical advisor within the 1Password Solutions Engineering organization. You’ll influence enterprise technology leaders, accelerate adoption of the 1Password platform and help define how modern organizations secure every sign-in to every application from every device, including AI agents.

You’ll partner with executive buyers, enterprise architects, developers and security practitioners to solve some of the industry’s most complex identity and access challenges. You’ll engage in our most strategic customer opportunities, represent 1Password in executive briefings, customer advisory boards, industry events and executive forums, and serve as a trusted advisor to Product, Engineering and GTM leadership. You’ll focus your efforts where executive technical leadership can materially influence customer outcomes, while transforming those experiences into repeatable technical motions that scale across the broader Solutions Engineering organization.

Beyond customer engagement, you’ll help scale the technical capabilities of the entire Solutions Engineering organization. You’ll transform customer insights into repeatable playbooks, mentor senior Solutions Engineers, influence product direction and establish technical strategies that improve how we engage enterprise customers around the world.

How We’re Using AI Today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What We're Looking For

12+ years of experience in enterprise technology, cybersecurity, consulting, solutions engineering, enterprise architecture or technical leadership roles.
Demonstrated success influencing executive technology leaders within Fortune 500 organizations.
Deep technical expertise across identity, access management, privileged access, cloud security, developer platforms, SaaS security or AI security.
Exceptional executive communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to simplify highly complex technical concepts into compelling narratives for executive audiences.
Proven ability to influence enterprise architecture decisions across large, complex organizations.
Experience supporting strategic enterprise sales opportunities and partnering closely with executive sales teams.
Strong understanding of enterprise buying processes and modern sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC.
Experience building technical strategies, reusable methodologies or customer engagement frameworks that scale beyond individual contributions.
Demonstrated ability to influence product strategy through customer engagement and market insights.
Proven ability to build trusted relationships across Product, Engineering, Sales and executive leadership while influencing without direct authority.
Experience speaking to diverse audiences at industry conferences, executive forums and analyst events.
Willingness to travel up to 50%.

Success in This Role

Within Your First 12 To 18 Months, You Will

Influence the successful outcome of 1Password’s most strategic customer opportunities and executive relationships.
Build trusted partnerships with Product, Engineering and GTM leadership that shape future platform investments.
Create repeatable technical plays, executive messaging and reference architectures adopted across the global Solutions Engineering organization.
Elevate the technical capabilities of the field through mentorship, thought leadership and executive engagement.
Expand 1Password’s influence across the identity security community through conference speaking, customer advisory boards and industry events.

What You Can Expect

Serve as a trusted technical advisor to strategic customers

Build relationships with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, Chief Architects and technical decision makers across Fortune 500 organizations.
Participate in executive briefings, architecture reviews and strategic workshops to help customers solve complex identity, access and security challenges.
Participate in executive customer meetings where senior technical leadership is needed to build consensus, align C-level priorities with technical teams and accelerate strategic initiatives.
Provide technical leadership throughout the sales cycle, helping account teams navigate architecture discussions, competitive evaluations and executive decision making.
Support our most strategic opportunities by accelerating technical alignment, reducing execution risk and building customer confidence.

Shape the Future of Solutions Engineering

Build repeatable technical motions, executive messaging, reference architectures and technical playbooks that scale across the global Solutions Engineering organization.
Mentor senior Solutions Engineers and help raise the technical and consultative capabilities of the broader team.
Partner with Sales Leadership, Solutions Engineering Leadership and Enablement to identify emerging technical trends, strategic opportunities and areas for organizational investment.
Develop enablement programs that prepare the field for emerging technologies and evolving customer challenges.
Serve as a technical thought leader across the organization, helping define best practices for enterprise engagement.

Influence Product Strategy

Serve as the executive voice of the field by bringing customer feedback, competitive intelligence and implementation insights directly to Product and Engineering leadership.
Partner with Product Management and Engineering to influence roadmap priorities, validate emerging capabilities and support early customer adoption programs.
Help translate emerging market trends into actionable product and GTM strategies.

Represent 1Password Externally

Speak at conferences, executive events, customer advisory boards, analyst briefings and industry forums.
Develop technical thought leadership through presentations, blogs, webinars, whitepapers and executive content.
Build credibility with customers, industry analysts, strategic partners and the broader security community while strengthening 1Password’s market position.
Be called upon to join high-impact, in-person customer engagements where executive technical leadership can build alignment, accelerate decision-making and strengthen strategic relationships.
Serve as the executive technical face of 1Password for our most strategic customers and partners.
Shape how 1Password engages enterprise organizations around identity security, AI, developer security and modern access management.
Partner directly with executive leadership across Product, Engineering, Marketing and Go-to-Market to influence company strategy.
Help define the future of Solutions Engineering by mentoring technical leaders and building scalable customer engagement models.
Represent 1Password on some of the industry’s biggest stages while helping organizations securely navigate the future of identity.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $228,000 USD and $342,000 USD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $228,000 CAD and $342,000 CAD and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How We Work With AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.

Our approach to work
